deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Please note that these instructions are specific to Shopify's current admin interface.
To embed a returns reason capture form into a Shopify returns flow, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Shopify Admin and navigate to Settings > Checkout
2. Click on the 'Themes' tab and select the theme you want to edit
3. Click on the 'Actions' dropdown menu and select 'Edit code'
4. In the 'Layout' folder, open the 'returns.liquid' file (or create a new one if it doesn't exist)

5. Add the following code snippet to capture returns reason: 

<form id='return-reason-form'>
  <label for='reason'>Reason for return:</label>
  <select id='reason' name='reason'>
    <option value='defective'>Defective</option>
    <option value='not-as-described'>Not as described</option>
    <option value='change-of-mind'>Change of mind</option>
    <!-- Add more options as needed -->
  </select>
  <button type='submit' id='submit-return-reason'>Submit</button>
</form>
7. In your Shopify theme's settings, navigate to 'Preferences' and enable the 'Returns' feature
8. Configure the returns flow as needed in your Shopify Admin
